title: His boyhood drum set: rope-tension drums and single-head snare
summary: Describes rope-tension bass and snare drums, rosin on the ropes, a single head with gut snares, and having only cymbals.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: I was going to ask you, before you got that far, about your drum set, when you started, when you were young, still just a boy, I guess. What kind of a drum set did you have? You had your old snare. Yeah. We had old snares.

We had bass drums. They had rope on them. I guess you done seen those. I've seen rounds of kids too, yeah. They have little rubber things like on them. You'd pull them, you'd grease them as rosim, you know, and you'd pull them down, that would tighten it. Yeah.

They wouldn't slip back because you'd grease past that rosim over the rope part, you see? Yeah. And they had little hooks on it. Every hook that he attached to the drum. And you'd pull that little piece down like that, and that would hold because you'd grease them as rosim, you see? And the snare drum I had during that time, this had one head.

Yeah. Just about a head. The snare drum? Yeah, the snare head, yeah. No bad. And how they had the snares was underneath that one, that head, that single head. Yeah, the snare head. Because I'd underneath that another part was open. Yeah. That's how we started.
Was there any difference in the sound of this?

Oh yeah, during that time. We didn't have more than snares like we have now, you know? It was something like a cap gut string, something like that. Oh yeah. It's like you'd put on violin a long time ago. Kind of red? Kind of red, that's right, that's where they were. Yeah, I see. And the bass drum there, it had those ropes like I see on there. Oh. And had those catches on there. You'd grease it with rosim, then you'd pull it down and it would hold it like that. Yeah.
Well, we only had cymbals. That's all cymbals and snare drum and that bass drum.
Any wood blocks or cowbells or anything like that? Well, not during that time.
